request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:FIGHTER

layers.text: Change only the colours of his clothes and skin: the red bandana and red tunic become near-black dark brown leather with two lighter brown stitched hide patches; dirty cream bandage wraps round both forearms; one small rusted iron shoulder plate painted with hazard yellow and black diagonal stripes; his skin a brighter, more saturated yellow-olive green. Keep the face, ears, dagger, belt, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
